independence_evidence: Self-published arts journal run by a small St. John's team (Riddle Fence Inc.), distributed nationally by Magazines Canada (https://riddlefence.com/about-riddle-fence/).
qualifies_reason: Independent Newfoundland literary journal with print Issue #58 (Summer 2026) on sale and Issue 59 launching 28 November 2026.
what_it_is: A journal of arts and culture from Newfoundland and Labrador that prints poetry, short fiction, creative non-fiction, features and reviews alongside contemporary visual art, with a strong regional base and contributors from across Canada and beyond. Issues carry contest winners and themed features. It is for readers of Canadian literary magazines and the Atlantic arts scene.
